lines.sub: Ramzan… sirf roza nahi, rehmat baantne ka mahina hai.
Jab mehnat karne walon ke haath mein ration pahunchta hai…
…to sirf ek bag nahi, poore ghar ki khushi ghar jaati hai.
Atta, chawal, khajoor, Rooh Afza… dastarkhwan par barkat aa jaati hai.
Aur rehmat… aage barhti rehti hai.
Zidane Ramzan packages: corporate, factory aur NGOs ke liye.
